We love, we learn, we live together
We love, we learn, we live together
Our School
St Joseph’s is a medium sized Catholic Primary School in Bridgwater, Somerset. The school is situated on lovely grounds, with a swimming pool, playing field and Forest School.
Message from Headteacher
St Joseph’s is a special place where every child has the opportunity to grow and develop in God’s love. We challenge each child to achieve high standards through a broad and balanced creative curriculum. Alison Frost.
Ofsted
"Pupils are proud to be part of this school. They demonstrate the school's values of 'stewardship, respect, curiosity, forgiveness and love' in their work and actions. Pupiles know that by following the school's values, they help to make the school a safe and happy place."
Safeguarding
St Joseph’s is committed to safeguarding, if you have any concerns about your, or any child at St Joseph’s please contact our Designated Safeguarding Lead; Mrs Frost or our Designated Deputy Safeguarding Leads Mrs Crow and Mrs Gibbard
Check out our 'Latest News' page to find out what has been happening in school.
Stewardship
Looking after the planet and respect everything on it to protect animals, plants and the future of the human race.
The Lord God took man and put him in the Garden of Eden to care for it and work it.
" We are a community of Catholic schools together aspiring to give children an all-round education rooted in Christian values in a nurturing environment where they flourish, become lifelong learners and fulfil their potential "

British Values
At St Joseph’s we aim to prepare our students to become good citizens of the future. In school we teach pupils British Values and how to celebrate diversity.
A group of Year 6 pupils have looked at the British Values of democracy, including liberty, respect for the law and respecting differences. They thought carefully about what these values look like in our school and have designed posters that are displayed around the school and presented these at a whole school assembly.
